profile_text.body:
SpaceX describes itself as a company that designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. According to its website, it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Starbase, Texas. It operates under the ticker SPCX and has CIK number 0001181412. It is also known as SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP and SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

Texas legal exposure data lists 126 entries for the company.
